You can always reply to this email to add additional information. Meanwhile, please note the following:If you paid your security deposit with a payment link before or on arrival, your deposit will be refunded within seven working days.If you paid your security deposit with a credit/debit card or via bank transfer on arrival with your guest relation executive, please expect the deposit to be refunded within a maximum of 14 working days. If you paid your security deposit in cash, it would be refunded in cash within 7 working days.If you have stayed for more than 15 days, then your booking would be considered as a long-term booking. All long-term bookings will be refunded within 14 working days as well.The refund will be processed in full through your preferred mode of payment, subject to a property inspection.To ensure a prompt refund, we kindly request you provide your preferred mode of refund (credit card, local bank account, cash, or international wire) to your dedicated guest relations executive as soon as possible. This will facilitate the timely return of funds to our valued guests.Below are the necessary fields and information required for a swift refund by bank transfer:Booking reference number:Beneficiary Name: Beneficiary Address:Beneficiary Bank Name:Beneficiary Bank Account Details (IBAN):Swift Code: Beneficiary Bank Address:Currency of Account:Sort Code:Kinds regards,Team fäm LivingOn Thu, May 14, 2026 2:35 PM, andreapiniella@gmail.com wrote:Good afternoon, Please find below information and bank account details for the refund of our deposit, as requested. - booking ref number: 149345- beneficiary name: ANDREA PINIELLA ALVAREZ- beneficiary address: 1701 Mayfair Tower, Business Bay, Dubai- beneficiary bank name: Emirates NBD- beneficiary IBAN: AE790260001015942926101- swift code: EBILAEADXXX- beneficiary bank address: 313,0,A7, 0,DIGITAL PARK, DXB PO BOX25788,DUBAI- currency: AEDWe paid one months rent (8500aed) plus 2000aed as the deposit. If you require anything else, please let me know. Could you kindly confirm via email once the refund is on my way please?Thanks, Andrea
